description: Part single, part two-storey side/rear extension involving conversion of garage into habitable room, front porch, rear dormer and erection of an outbuilding.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:D01, D03, D04, D05, D06, D08, D09, D10, D11, D12, D13 Rev1, D14 Rev1, D16Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The detached outbuilding hereby approved by this consent shall only be used for purposes incidental to the residential occupation of the property but excluding use for any form of habitable accommodation or business purposes.Reason: To ensure that the development is not used for unlawful purposes and to prevent the introduction of activity which would be detrimental to visual and residential amenities.
